name: engram
description: Local-only temporal memory for Claude Code sessions. Adds an MCP server, nine /engram: slash commands, and SessionStart, SubagentStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, and file-touched hooks backed by a single-binary, append-only SQLite store at ~/.engram — no account, and nothing that leaves your machine: the server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Facts are never mutated or deleted, only superseded, with the reason for every revision recorded.
